Every decision behind the scenes can make a difference on track.
Meet Sofia, Junior Cost Cap Analyst in Hinwil. She helps the Team use its resources efficiently, supporting the development of the car's performance. Discover her full story: https://www.audif1.com/news/2026/all-for-one-sofia?utm_source=x&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=audif1_all_for_one_sofia_2026_global
detailZh:
幕后每一个决定都可能对赛道上的表现产生影响。
认识一下索菲亚，她是青训车队的成本效益分析师，在欣威尔工作。她帮助车队高效地使用资源，支持汽车性能的发展。了解她的完整故事：https://www.audif1.com/news/2026/all-for-one-sofia?utm_source=x&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=audif1_all_for_one_sofia_2026_global
